samples.question: The four lamps start as shown. Read the five VOTE cards from left to right. Each card's blue-dot count names one lamp, and its green CHECK strip repeats that count. Replace the named lamp's state with the majority state of the other three lamps: it becomes ON when at least two of them are ON, and OFF otherwise. The other lamps stay unchanged. Is the magenta-ringed lamp ON or OFF at the end?
